newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway approves of Fokus, Codan life insurer.
newsitem.headline: Norway approves of Fokus, Codan life insurer.

text.p: The Norwegian Finance Ministry on Tuesday formally approved of a plan by Norway's Fokus Bank and Denmark's Codan Forsikring to set up a joint life insurer, an Oslo bourse statement said on Tuesday.
The parties announced last August that the new company would offer a range of life and pension insurances through Fokus Bank branches.
Headquarters will be in Trondheim, which is also the headquarters of Fokus. The life insurer will have a share capital of 100 million crowns.
Fokus, Norway's third largest commercial bank, agreed in December 1995 to form an alliance with Codan, Denmark's second largest insurer.
